capability_requirements.description: Lightweight, RFC-4180 compliant CSV parser with quoted string and multi-line cell support
Deterministic column-by-column sanitization masking PANs, SSNs, and escaping formula injection prefixes (=, @, +, -)
Accessible preview grid showing sanitized rows, column headers, and live error banners

candidate_options.name: Bundled PapaParse + External SheetJS Parser
cons: Vulnerable to prototype pollution and CVEs in legacy SheetJS versions
High memory allocation on client thread

candidate_options.name: Custom BKM-Informed Vanilla Streaming CSV Sanitizer
pros: Direct edge sanitization for PII & CSV formula injection
cons: Limited to delimiter-separated text (CSV, TSV, pipe)

negative_transfer_evaluation.justification: BKM-CANARY-001 relies on character-by-character regex sanitization at the DOM input boundary. Applying this to high-concurrency binary stream buffers causes 400% throughput degradation. Binary streaming requires zero-copy framing, not DOM regex filters.

selected_approach: Custom BKM-Informed Vanilla Streaming CSV Sanitizer
justification: Extends BKM-CANARY-001 into tabular CSV data with formula injection defense and zero bundle bloat.
